findings.title: Do not renumber the existing recreate-upgrade exit code
findings.body: `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` was changed from 4 to 3 while the command is explicitly documented as scriptable and consumers are told to rely on its exit code. Existing automation that interprets exit code 4 as “recreate required” will, after upgrading, either receive 3 unexpectedly or misinterpret the new 4 feature-disabled result as a recreate requirement. Preserve the existing code and assign the new feature-disabled condition a previously unused value (or provide an explicit compatibility/migration strategy).
